🗣️ Transform from memorizing a few phrases to speaking fluently in English, Spanish, or French in our virtual world!

❤️ IMMERSE is the #1 ranked VR language learning app used by over 200,000+ adults in over 73 countries.

💪 Get unlimited access to live group classes, community meet ups & AI-powered conversation practice!  

📚 Research shows IMMERSE is 4x more effective than leading language learning apps and tutoring services!

🥳 Start your 14-day free trial today! 

***

👩‍🏫 INSTRUCTOR-LED LESSONS

Practice key language skills in 40-minute small group lessons led by friendly instructors. Don't forget to review your personalized notes after class too! New lessons available 7 days per week! 

💃🕺🏼 COMMUNITY MEETUPS

Enjoy connecting with our diverse global community in fun, casual events happening 7 days per week.

🗣 AI-POWERED CONVERSATION PRACTICE

Build your public speaking confidence through vocabulary, pronunciation, and guided roleplay conversation practice powered by our GenAI avatars in our virtual world.

🎯 LANGUAGE GAMES 

Shoot targets, sing karaoke, play basketball, and compete with friends to refine your vocabulary. 

📈 PERSONALIZED LEARNING PATH

Track your progress across your fluency level in your personalized Learning Path. Review your completed tasks, see how you've grown in unique communication skills, and what activities you have left to progress to the next level.

Start your free 14 day trial today! Cancel anytime. Must be 18 years or older to join.
